slug: 2026-05-23 Guinea-Bissau CNT passes Digital Integrity (online falsehoods) Law

systems.system: Lei de Disseminação de Informações Falsas na Internet (Lei da Integridade Digital)
systems.country_label: Lei de Disseminação de Informações Falsas na Internet

note: A speech law passed by the CNT with no one reported charged under it; class other, no fact.

systems.owner: created by the Digital Integrity Law; refers cases to the Ministério Público

note: A false-content law and its commission, no one reported charged, no cut and no named critic; class other, no fact.
A CPLP charter of principles for all member states; it names no GNB event, cut, arrest or repeal.
The ministry denies any TikTok ban and says it will identify the authors of the rumour; no cut, no one arrested or charged, so no fact.

facts.fact: On 26 November 2025, the day the military seized power, citizens reported widespread restrictions on Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, which the Media Foundation for West Africa (MFWA) says the military imposed; the source gives no end date.

note: Radio stations were ordered off air and journalists out of their premises by the military on 26 November 2025, but the source does not say it was for what was said or published, so no penalty fact.
Critics are unnamed journalists and groups; no cut or punishment stated.
Nothing on public debate, cuts or punishment.

facts.fact: Access Now lists Guinea-Bissau among 15 African countries where internet shutdowns were implemented in 2025.
